context_window_source: OpenAI model documentation for gpt-5.6-sol (https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.6-sol), checked 2026-10-05: 922,000 max input and 128,000 max output tokens; prompts above 272,000 input tokens are priced higher. The Azure deployment is assumed not to lower this limit; override if it does.
organisational_approval_note: Approval for sending Bouw source to the gpt-5.6-sol deployment confirmed by the user (thesis author) in session on 2026-10-05.
note: rate_limit_tokens_per_minute is the deployment throughput limit (236,000 TPM, given by the user 2026-10-05); it is not the context window. Set context_window_confirmed_tokens from the deployment documentation and record organisational approval; replay_freeze.py then writes the freeze record. Enable live execution only after the freeze.
output_cap_amendment: Raised from 4,096 to 16,384 on 2026-10-05 after the live smoke call (T08, calibration target): the reasoning model used all 4,096 completion tokens on reasoning for a ~15k-token prompt and returned no content. Amendment 0.3.1, before any validation call.
allocation_amendment: Raised from 160,000 to 320,000 on 2026-10-05 after calibration: all three T10 trajectories were stopped before step 4 by the per-branch allocation (about 97k spent plus a conservative reservation of about 63k), not by failure. Amendment 0.3.3, before any validation call.
